summary: This note describes Under the Northern Sky, the debut full-length album by the Finnish melodic death metal band Immortal Souls. It was the last recording released by the band's previous record label, Little Rose Productions, in 2001.
one_line: Debut full-length album by Finnish melodic death metal band Immortal Souls, released in 2001 on Little Rose Productions.
key_facts: Under the Northern Sky is the first full-length album by the Finnish melodic death metal band Immortal Souls.
The album was the last recording released by the band's previous record label, Little Rose Productions.
The album was released in 2001 according to the note.
Little Rose Productions was the previous record label of Immortal Souls.
Immortal Souls is a Finnish melodic death metal band.
The note describes the album as the band's first full-length release.
